hints.title: Root Selection in Range
hints.text: For numbers from 1 to n, pick each number as root. Subtrees partition strictly into numbers less than root and numbers greater.

hints.title: Cartesian Product of Subtrees
hints.text: Combine every generated left subtree from the smaller range with every generated right subtree from the larger range.

hints.title: Recursive Range Tree Construction
hints.text: Define helper(start, end). If start > end, return a list containing null. Otherwise loop root val from start to end, recursively getting all left subtrees from (start, val - 1) and all right subtrees from (val + 1, end). Link root to all combinations of left and right.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes (Catalan number C_N)
complexity.notes: Optimal generation bounded by the Catalan number count of structurally unique BSTs.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations and inserting into a BST generates duplicate identical trees.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Divide and conquer on subranges constructs each distinct tree structure exactly once.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Understand the Catalan number recurrence and construct all pairs of left and right subtrees recursively.
